name: print-social-creative-studio-poster-peach-3d-megaphone-rings
title: 'Creative Studio 15% Off' poster with a glossy pink 3D megaphone and concentric ring shapes
whatItIs: A peach-orange A4 poster with a serif italic 'CREATIVE STUDIO' headline, a bold pink '15% OFF', two rounded white service cards (Graphic Design, Web Design) with pricing pills, a glossy pink 3D megaphone with small floating glass spheres, and concentric orange-pink target rings.
whatItMeans: Warm and premium; a soft glossy 3D megaphone gives an announcement poster real tactile appeal without feeling loud.
techniques: Render a symbolic object (a megaphone) as a soft glossy 3D form.
Pair service pricing with rounded white cards on a colour field.
Add concentric ring shapes as a soft target motif.

vocabulary.definition: A card pairing a service name with its price.
